script:
Title: The Visitor
Starts: dusk
Name: Haruki
Player: Haruki, 28, lives alone in his late mother's apartment; off his pills
Kind: first-person horror, one night, one apartment, about 80 minutes, three endings
Logline: On the last night of Obon, a woman he should know comes to visit.
Natsuki (she): Natsuki Kikuchi, 23, Natsumi's little sister; Haruki sees her as Natsumi
Sasaki (he): Officer Sasaki, local police
Officer (he): a younger officer
Kikuchi (she): Mrs Kikuchi, the sisters' mother, phone only
Ren (he): Natsuki's boyfriend, phone only
Akiko (she): Haruki's dead mother, a voice in his head
Voice (she): a girl's voice, phone only
@ Living room: kitchen and living room: low table, kettle, hob, fridge, TV, landline, balcony door
@ Genkan: entrance: shoes, shoe cabinet, front door (peephole, latch)
@ Bathroom: sink cabinet (pills), washing machine, bath
@ Guest room: tatami room: Obon altar (two cucumber horses, drawer), oshiire (futons)
@ Haruki's room: bed, desk (diary), taped closet
@ Balcony: view of the river
@ Garden: downstairs: bench, vending machine

Note: HOW IT'S WRITTEN. The player knows nothing, and neither does Haruki's head: his thoughts only know what's in front of him and what his body remembers ("My hands know where the cups are."). Facts come from outside him, once each: the to-do list, her lines, the props, the officer, the phone. He never speaks a line; his answers are a small act and a thought, and the player imagines what he said.
Note: {her} = Natsu off his pills, Natsuki after one. Use it in his thoughts and in the speaker name.
Note: karma = his clarity. Pill taken +1, pill left -1, romance answer -1, lying to Ren -1. Everything else 0.
Note: Off his pills her faces are his version (romantic). After a pill: her real faces (confused, afraid). Shoot both for the talks marked (2 faces).

( Opening )

@ Living room

*wait 60s*

Note: one minute of free look round the apartment. No list, no thoughts.

Timed task (2 min) - Clean up the apartment before Natsu arrives

"Natsu."

"Someone's coming."

Task - Take out the rubbish

Task - Wash the dishes

Task - Wipe the low table

Task - Bring in the laundry

Task - Set out the Obon altar

Task - Put the pill organiser away

Note: the timer stays hidden; only the tasks show. Not done in time: failed, and she comments.

*read the card on the fridge*

Haru-nii, I'm coming home for Obon. Can I visit on the 16th? I want to talk about Onee-chan. Natsuki.

"Natsu. She's coming here."

*look at the photo on the fridge*

A girl in a red yukata. A smaller girl holding her sleeve.

"I know her. I know that face."

*look at the Obon altar (large)*

Two cucumber horses.

"Why two?"

*turn on the TV*

News: a woman from the next town, missing since the 12th.

*look at the taped closet (large)*

"Not today."

*knock, knock*

( Secret: Black Border )

Find: *read the black-bordered letter*

Achievement: Black Border - Read the letter before she arrives

Natsumi Kikuchi. Declared deceased this spring.

"Deceased?"

( The Visitor )

@ Genkan

*look through the peephole*

Natsuki: "Haru-nii? It's me."

"That voice."

[ Greet ] She looks cold, welcome her inside --- [ Question ] She looks different.

[ Greet ]
Natsuki: (smiles) "Finally."

[ Question ]
Natsuki: (puzzled, then smiles) "Are you going to open the door?"

[ Either way ]

*open the door*

*Natsuki walks in*

Natsuki: (smiles, a little shy) "Twelve years, Haru-nii. Can you believe it?"

[ Smile ] She knows me. Smile back --- [ Look ] Twelve years? It feels like last week.

[ Smile ]
Natsuki: (2 faces: his, a happy smile; hers, the smile falters) "You haven't changed."

[ Look ]
Natsuki: (uneasy laugh) "Is there something on my face?"

[ Either way ]

Note: her comment on the flat comes from the clean-up: spotless (Spotless) or nothing done (Lived-In).

Request from Natsuki - Put the watermelon in a bucket of water

( Tea )

@ Living room

*Natsuki sits at the low table*

Request from Natsuki - Make tea

*turn on the kettle*

"My hands know where the cups are."

*give the tea to Natsuki*

Natsuki: (2 faces: his, pleased; hers, her mouth tightens, then polite) "Perfect."

Note: sugar 0, 1 or 2; the inner monologue only says "Two. My hand already knows." Two is Natsumi's way (Two Sugars). Soy sauce is a second secret beside Purified (Secret Recipe), added in the director.

( Secret: Purified )

Find: *put salt in her tea*

Achievement: Purified - Salt in her tea

Natsuki: (coughs, then laughs) "Salt?"

( The Altar )

@ Guest room

*Natsuki lights incense at the altar*

*look at the photo on the altar*

"Mom."

Natsuki: (looks at the altar, then at you, worried) "Who's the second horse for?"

[ Mom ] They're both for Mom. Aren't they? --- [ Say nothing ] I don't remember making two.

( Somen )

@ Living room

Request from Natsuki - Make somen

*boil the water*

*rinse the somen*

*cut the negi*

*give the somen to Natsuki*

"Someone always stole my negi. Someone—"

Natsuki: "Do you still go down to the river?"

[ Nod ] My shoes are always muddy. I must --- [ Shake head ] I don't go out.

[ Nod ]
Natsuki: (looks down) "...Even today."

[ Shake head ]
Natsuki: (studies your face, nods) "Okay."

[ Either way ]

( Secret: Old Times )

Find: *give her your negi*

Achievement: Old Times - Give her your negi

Natsuki: (smiles, forces it down) "Thanks."

( The Officer )

@ Genkan

*fireworks*

*doorbell*

*open the door*

Sasaki: "Evening. A woman's missing from the next town."

Sasaki: "Natsuki-chan? Home for Obon?"

"Natsuki? He means Natsu."

Sasaki: "Onodera. Twelve years today."

"Twelve years since what?"

Sasaki: "I always wondered about the Sakamoto boy."

[ Tense ] That name. My jaw is tight --- [ Blank ] Sakamoto? I don't know him.

[ Tense ]
Sasaki: (stares a moment) "Still, after all this time."

[ Blank ]
Sasaki: (nods slowly) "Goodnight."

[ Either way ]

*close the door*

Natsuki: (worried) "Everything okay?"

[ Lock it ] Lock it. Twice. Check it again --- [ Leave it ] He's gone. It's fine.

( Watermelon )

@ Balcony

*cut the watermelon*

*Natsuki eats watermelon on the balcony*

*fireworks*

"Salt on watermelon. Mom did that."

( Secret: Seed Spitter )

Find: *spit the seeds off the balcony*

Achievement: Seed Spitter - Win the seed contest

Natsuki: (laughs) "No fair."

( Pill 1 )

@ Bathroom

*open the cabinet*

*look at the pharmacy bag*

Onodera Haruki. Once a day, after dinner.

Akiko: "Did you take them, Haru?"

"Mom?"

[ Take them +1 ] Her voice. Just one, for her --- [ Leave them -1 ] I feel fine. Better than fine.

Note: in the director this is a timed to-do, Take your pills, that fails when its time is up.

( The Bath )

Request from Natsuki - Run the bath

*run the bath*

*Natsuki goes into the bathroom*

( While She Bathes )

@ Living room

*look in her bag*

Student ID: Kikuchi Natsuki.

"Natsuki."

*phone rings*

*answer the phone*

Kikuchi: "Is my daughter there? Natsuki?"

[ Fetch her ] That name again. She's in the bath --- [ Hang up ] Wrong number. It must be.

( Secret: The Wall )

Find: *open the taped closet*

Achievement: The Wall - Open the taped closet

@ Haruki's room

Missing posters. String. A photo of the girl in the red yukata and a boy, his face scratched out. One wooden sandal.

"That's my handwriting."

( The Album )

@ Living room

*Natsuki sits at the low table*

*look at the album*

Caption: Ko-natsu & Haru-nii. The last photo is folded.

"Ko-natsu. The little one."

( Secret: The Folded Photo )

Find: *unfold the last photo*

Achievement: The Folded Photo - Unfold the last photo

The girl in the red yukata and a boy, holding hands.

( The Cards )

Natsuki: "Cards? Loser answers a question. Like when we were kids."

*play cards at the low table*

Note: shinkei-suijaku (Concentration), a new rules module. Off his pills: his memory lies and she lets him win. After a pill: true cards, she wins.

Natsuki: "Where were you at eleven that night?"

[ Home ] Home. Mom always said so --- [ What night ] What night? --- [ Trees ] Trees. Rain. Why do I see trees?

[ Home ]
Natsuki: (face goes still) "That's what she said."

[ What night ]
Natsuki: (careful) "You really don't know?"

[ Trees ]
Natsuki: (freezes) "...The woods?"

[ Either way ]

Note: off his pills only Home is offered.

( The Garden ) if karma 1+

@ Garden

*go to the garden*

*Natsuki smokes on the bench*

Natsuki: (crying) "I'm Natsuki, Haru-nii. Natsumi's gone."

[ Ko-natsu ] Ko-natsu. The little one. It was always her --- [ Gone ] Gone? Gone where?

[ Ko-natsu ]
Natsuki: (wipes her eyes, almost smiles) "...You remember me."

[ Gone ]
Natsuki: (stares) "Twelve years ago. Tonight."

[ Either way ]

Natsuki: "Ren says I shouldn't have come."

( The Garden ) otherwise

@ Garden

*go to the garden*

*Natsuki smokes on the bench*

Natsuki: (smiles, offers the cigarette) "Don't tell my mom."

Natsuki: "Do you remember that night?"

[ Hold her hand -1 ] She wants me to --- [ Wait ] What night? Everyone keeps saying that night.

[ Hold her hand ]
Natsuki: (2 faces: his, she leans in; hers, she pulls her hand away) "Haru-nii..."

[ Wait ]
Natsuki: (looks at you a long moment) "It's late."

[ Either way ]

Note: her shoes are gone from the genkan before this. Off his pills, every line about Ren is cut.

( 23:47 )

@ Garden

*buy two cans from the vending machine*

@ Living room

*phone rings*

*answer the phone*

Voice: "Moshi."

[ Moshi moshi ] Say it twice. Mom always did --- [ Hang up ] Nobody's there.

[ Moshi moshi ]
Voice: "Mō ii yo."
Achievement: Moshi Moshi - Answer the 23:47 call properly

[ Either way ]

( Pill 2 )

@ Bathroom

*open the cabinet*

Akiko: "Haru. The pills."

[ Take them +1 ] It's getting loud. One more --- [ Leave them -1 ] If I take them, she'll go.

( Ramen )

@ Living room

Natsuki: "I'm starving."

Request from Natsuki - Make ramen

*boil the water*

*crack the egg*

*give the ramen to Natsuki*

Natsuki: "I'll take the first train tomorrow."

"Tomorrow. She's leaving."

( The Futon )

@ Guest room

Request from Natsuki - Lay out the futon

*open the oshiire*

*lay out the futon*

*Natsuki goes to bed*

( Secret: Mother's Drawer )

Find: *open the altar's drawer*

Achievement: Mother's Drawer - Open the altar's drawer

Diary: I'd lie for him again.

"Lie about what?"

( Ushimitsu )

@ Living room

*the power goes out*

*take the flashlight*

*turn on the flashlight*

*phone rings*

*answer the phone*

Ren: "Is Natsuki there? It's Ren."

[ Wake her ] Someone's worried about her --- [ Lie -1 ] Someone else. Wrong number.

[ Wake her ]
Natsuki: (sleepy) "Thanks, Haru-nii."

[ Either way ]

*flip the breaker*

Note: off his pills: the altar bell rings, the TV says his name, knocking in the oshiire.

( Pill 3 )

@ Living room

Natsuki: "Can't sleep. More tea?"

Request from Natsuki - Make tea

*turn on the kettle*

*give the tea to Natsuki*

Natsuki: (looks at your hands) "You're shaking."

[ Take them +1 ] My hands won't stop. Take them --- [ Leave them -1 ] She said she'd stay.

( Two O'Clock ) if karma -5 or less

@ Guest room

Natsuki: "Goodnight, Haru-nii."

[ Watch her sleep ] Just for a moment. She said she'd stay --- [ Go to bed ] Let her sleep.

( Ending: Stay ) if [ Watch her sleep ]

@ Living room

Note: CUTSCENE SLOT, built in the director. Then the TITLE CARD: Stay.

Clock: 02:10, then 03:40.

*knock, knock*

Sasaki: "Police. A neighbour heard a disturbance."

*the officer walks to the guest room*

Officer: "On your knees! Hands up!"

Flashes: her real faces. The woods. His hands on her shoulders. The river.

"This time, she stayed."

Achievement: Stay - The secret ending

( True ending: Okuribi ) if karma 1+

@ Genkan

Note: CUTSCENE SLOT, built in the director. Then the TITLE CARD: Okuribi.

*Natsuki gives you a paper wish*

I wish Haru-kun will always be my big brother. Natsumi.

Natsuki: "Shun said you followed them. Your mom said you were home."

*light the fire at the door*

*Natsuki leaves*

Achievement: Okuribi - The intended ending

( Ending: Thank You for Tonight ) otherwise

@ Living room

Note: CUTSCENE SLOT, built in the director. Then the TITLE CARD: Thank You for Tonight.

*Natsuki leaves*

*answering machine beeps*

Natsuki: "Thanks for last night. You called me Natsu all night."

*read the diary*

I let them blame him.

Achievement: Thank You for Tonight - The other ending
